description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeCustomFieldAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system. It handles REST API endpoints for listing and updating custom fields associated with an employee in the HRM system. The class includes methods for retrieving custom fields, updating employee custom field values, and their respective validation rules, leveraging various traits and services.

classes.name: EmployeeCustomFieldAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for listing and updating custom fields for an employee in OrangeHRM. It extends the Endpoint class and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing traits for services and user role management, and integrating with the entity models and services for custom fields and employees.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the custom field values for a specific employee, optionally filtered by screen, and returns normalized data along with metadata.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates custom field values for a specific employee, validating permissions and input, then persists changes and returns updated data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, including employee number validation and optional 'screen' parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' endpoint, including employee number validation and rules for custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsParamsRules
methods.description: Generates validation rules for each custom field parameter (custom1 to custom10).

methods.name: getUrlParams
methods.description: Extracts and returns employee number and screen parameters from the request.

methods.name: getEmployeeCustomFieldsByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Builds an array of custom field values for an employee based on field numbers.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromCustomFields
methods.description: Extracts field numbers from an array of CustomField entities.
